d: A newly published private diary of Pope Francis has revealed startling personal accounts of his spiritual experiences, including claims that he encountered the Devil three times and once dreamed of the gates of Hell. Published on November 24, the book reportedly contains notes written by Pope Francis from 1992 until his death. It has been brought out by Cardinal Víctor Manuel Fernández, a close associate of the late Pope and a senior Vatican official.
